4a:T47c,Thales disclosed in its 2025 consolidated financial statements three sets of ongoing investigations: a judicial investigation opened in 2022 into the business relations of Gemalto before Thales acquired it in 2019; two preliminary investigations by the French Parquet National Financier in which sites in France, the Netherlands and Spain were searched in June 2024; and an investigation announced by the UK Serious Fraud Office on 2024-11-21, run jointly with the PNF, into four Thales entities in France and the UK regarding a project in Asia.
